title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence Warning Model Using an Ensemble Approach for In-Hospital Cardiac Arrest Prediction: Retrospective Cohort Study
summary: An interpretable ensemble predicted in-hospital cardiac arrest from retrospective clinical time series; the paper reports discrimination, warning time, and false-alarm performance in its cohort.
